Reading 4 min

Who is it?

Read each description. Which photo is it?

  1. She is wearing a necklace with a butterfly. Her hair is short and twisted into locks.
  2. He is in his early twenties. He has curly dark hair and freckles on his nose and cheeks.
  3. He is about fifty. He has no hair at all, and he is wearing a black suit and tie.
  4. The man has a small beard just under his lower lip. He is wearing a light blue jacket.
  5. She has long blond hair pulled up high. We can only see her from the side.
  6. He is quite young, but his hair is getting thin at the front.

Each description has one wrong detail. Find it.

  1. Photo 6. “The man has a mustache, thick eyebrows and short blond hair. He is wearing a gray sweatshirt.” Wrong detail:
  2. Photo 9. “The man is bald. He has a mustache, a black tie and a white shirt.” Wrong detail:
  3. Photo 7. “The man has a goatee, blue eyes and glasses. He is wearing a light blue jacket.” Wrong detail:

Grammar 3 min

Look like or be like?

What does she look like? → appearance: She’s tall, with long hair.

What is she like? → personality: She’s friendly and funny.

  1. What does your sister look like?
  2. What is your sister like?
  3. What does the new teacher look like?
  4. What is the new teacher like?
Free practice 5 min

Photos A–C

Describe the people in photos A–C. Use the structure and the frames.

Four steps1 He / She looks about … / is in his / her … 2 He / She has … hair and … (eyes)3 with a … / is wearing …4 He / She looks / seems …
Example

The man looks about thirty-five. He has short dark hair and a full beard. He is wearing a white T-shirt, and a tattoo covers his arm. He looks serious, maybe a little tired.

Free practice 4 min

Compare two men

Compare two men. What is the same? What is different?

ComparingBoth men …He has …, but he has …He is older / younger than …He looks more … than …On the other hand, …
Example

Both men look serious. The man in photo 9 is bald, but the man in photo 12 has thick curly hair. The first man looks older than the second one. On the other hand, they are both wearing dark clothes.

Compare two photos

Free practice 4 min

Airport message

You are meeting a friend at the airport, but you have not seen each other for years. Write a text message so he can find you. Say what you look like and what you will be wearing.

FramesI’m tall / of medium height, with …I have short dark hair and …I’ll be wearing …I’ll be standing next to …
Example

Hi! I’m tall, with short dark hair and a little stubble. I will be wearing a gray jacket and jeans, and I will be standing next to the coffee shop.

Message

Free practice 4 min

Guess who?

Describe a famous person or a character from a movie without saying the name. Your teacher guesses who it is. Write five sentences.

FramesHe / She is in his / her …has … hair and …is known for …looks …Who is it?
Example

He is in his fifties. He is bald and has a gray goatee. He is known for playing tough characters in action movies.

Guess who?

Free practice 4 min

Two people you know

Describe two people you know well: a family member and a friend. Use at least five words from this lesson (for example bangs, braids, stubble, freckles, receding hairline, mustache).

Example

My brother is in his early twenties. He is tall and slim with short curly hair and stubble. My best friend has long straight hair with bangs, and she always wears glasses.

Two people

Required Homework

Voice message: describe a picture

Required homework

Record a voice message (1–2 minutes) in which you describe a picture of a person. Use the topic of this lesson. Send it to your teacher before the next lesson.

Choose one: a photo from this page (1–12 or A–C), or any photo of a person you like (a friend, a family member, an actor).

Say it in four steps1 He / She looks about … / is in his / her …2 He / She has … hair and …3 with a … / is wearing …4 He / She looks … / seems …I think …
Example

The woman looks about twenty. She has short dreadlocks and a nose piercing. She is wearing hoop earrings and a necklace with a butterfly. She looks calm, and I think she is sitting in a car.
